$Comment: What a member of the Brood Queen fight sees as she changes and the brood comes up: one quiet
line in the notice feed, in the plain tone, because a phase is a beat inside the fight and not
a payout. The queen's binding row points its PhaseChanged beat here (Feedback.PhaseChanged),
so the words belong to this fight alone.
The moment fires once per live member at each phase and carries 'phase' (the script's state
name, Phase_2 or Phase_3) should a line want to name it; this one keeps the same words for
both changes on purpose, since the brood rising says which is which. Set Tone to Error for a
red line, or add a Sound for a hiss.
